# mistershell_syslog_rule_order (Resource)

Owns the complete policy evaluation order. Use one resource per policy family. Destroy forgets ordering without changing or deleting rules. Requires MisterShell 2.1 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_syslog_rule_order" "example" {
  # Include all existing rule IDs, including the server's fallback policy.
  ordered_ids = var.all_syslog_rule_ids_in_order
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ordered_ids` (List of Number) Complete ordered list of existing rule IDs, including rules managed outside Terraform. Duplicates or incomplete sets are rejected before writing.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identity: policy.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mistershell_syslog_rule_order.example policy
```
